cues: Addition: moreover, furthermore, besides; in addition to before a noun.
Contrast: although with a clause, however as a marker, in spite of or despite with a noun.
Cause: because, since, as with a clause; because of, owing to, due to with a noun.
Result: so that and such that; therefore, consequently, hence.
Purpose: so that with a clause, in order to with a verb.
Condition: if, unless, provided that; otherwise as a marker.
Time: when, while, until, as soon as; then, meanwhile, finally.
